title: Bitcoin Mining Firm Luxor Raises $16 Million to Scale AI Compute Trading and Hardware
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Mining Firm Luxor Raises $16 Million to Scale AI Compute Trading and Hardware Luxor, a bitcoin miner turned AI compute firm, raised $16 million led by CMT Digital to expand its AI hardware brokerage and compute trading business. This post Bitcoin Mining Firm Luxor Raises $16 Million to Scale AI Compute Trading and Hardware first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
